The '''''Stars of Elrood''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] owned and operated by [[Shondra Del]]. Del, an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[operative]], used the freighter as part of her cover working in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]].
